response: ["The 7-point score is driven by the streaks, pigmentation, and dots_and_globules criteria.","Streaks are irregular and contribute 1 point to the score.","Pigmentation is diffuse irregular and contributes 1 point to the score.","Dots_and_globules are irregular and contribute 1 point to the score.","The major criteria pigment_network, blue_whitish_veil, and vascular_structures are absent and contribute 0 points.","Regression_structures are absent and contribute 0 points.","Irregular streaks appear as unevenly distributed radial lines or pseudopods.","Diffuse irregular pigmentation appears as asymmetric blotches of pigment.","Irregular dots/globules appear as varied size and uneven distribution.","Dermatoscopy should be used for assessment of pigmented and non-pigmented skin lesions (eado:pmid:39700658:recommendation-4).","Whole-body photography with sequential examinations should be used for early detection of melanoma in high-risk patients (eado:pmid:39700658:recommendation-5)."]
